name: Automated Financial Statement Template for Trading Businesses (Excel)
lead: Keep tidier transaction records, track your profit, and understand your company's financial position, all in one Excel file.
body:
Just enter your opening balances, record your transactions, and fill in your inventory data. The financial statements update automatically based on what you enter.

What's included?

  • Transaction Records, for recording income, expenses, purchases, sales and other financial transactions.
  • Automated Financial Statements, covering the General Ledger, Trial Balance, Income Statement, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.
  • Inventory Stock Cards, to track the movement of goods and calculate ending inventory value and COGS (HPP) using the periodic method.
  • Financial Performance Summary, showing sales, profit, cash, assets, liabilities and equity on one dashboard.
  • Financial Ratio Analysis, to help you read your company's liquidity, profitability and overall financial health.
  • Step-by-Step Guide, so users can easily understand how to fill in and use each worksheet.

Why this template

  • Two files: a blank file ready to fill in, and a sample file that shows how the template works.
  • You can add your own accounts to suit your business, and new accounts flow into the reports automatically.
  • Report formulas are already built in.
  • Includes checks on transactions and on whether the statements balance.
  • One file per reporting period: monthly, quarterly or annual.

Who is it for?

Owners of trading companies, management, and admin and finance teams who want more structured record-keeping and financial statements that are easy to understand.

Manage your company's numbers more clearly, so financial decisions are not based on guesswork alone.

name: Automated COGS Calculation Template for Businesses
lead: Calculate your cost of production the way cost accountants do, without needing to understand accounting.
body:
What this template tells you

  • The true cost of making one unit of each product
  • How much of your COGS (HPP) comes from materials, labor and overhead
  • The gap between the cost according to your recipe and the cost actually incurred, so material waste shows up quickly
  • The minimum selling price needed to hit your target margin
  • Which products are the most profitable and which need a second look
  • Your operating profit and the minimum sales needed to avoid a loss
  • An easy-to-read one-page summary for making decisions

Easy to use and customizable

  • Step-by-step guide to filling it in
  • All sheets are linked: enter your data once and the results are calculated automatically
  • You can add your own products, raw materials and cost items to fit your business
  • Automatic checks that flag data that is incomplete or looks unusual

What you receive

  • A blank file, ready to fill in with your company's data
  • A sample file, to see how the template works before you start

Ideal for: manufacturing and production companies that make or assemble their own products and want to calculate COGS correctly.

Before you buy

The template is a Microsoft Excel file. Just fill in the yellow cells and everything else is calculated automatically.

This template is a calculation tool, not a substitute for advice from an accountant or tax consultant.

name: Personal Financial Planning Template
lead: Know where your family's finances stand, without doing the math by hand.
body:
This Excel template brings together your budget plan, transaction records, net worth statement, financial goals and a financial health check in one file.

Key feature: financial health check-up

Get a financial health score based on ratios commonly used by financial planners. Each indicator is given a status straight away, along with suggested next steps. You can also adjust the ratio thresholds yourself.

What you'll find out

  • Where your money goes each month, and which categories go over budget
  • What your net worth is today, and how your assets and debts are made up
  • Whether your emergency fund is large enough
  • How much you need to set aside each month for your children's education, retirement or other goals, with inflation already taken into account
  • Whether your contributions to each goal are on track or falling short
  • Your financial position month by month and as a yearly average, on one summary page

Easy to use and customizable

  • Step-by-step guide to the workflow
  • Pick transaction categories from a drop-down list
  • Add your own budget, asset, debt and financial goal categories
  • Record assets and debts separately for you and your partner
  • Fill in the yellow cells and the rest is calculated automatically. No formula skills needed.

Ideal for

  • Couples and families who want to start keeping their finances in order
  • People who already track their spending but don't yet know whether their finances are healthy
  • People with goals such as their children's education, retirement or a holiday, who don't yet know how much to set aside

What you get

  • A blank file, ready to fill in with your own financial data
  • A sample file with a family's data, so you can see right away how it works

Microsoft Excel format, prepared by Harsha Advisory.

Want to go deeper into your check-up results? We also offer 1-on-1 consultations with a financial planner, which can be booked separately from this template.

name: Business Feasibility Study Template
lead: A business plan can look promising on paper, but will you really get your capital back?
body:
What's included?

  • Feasibility Dashboard, see whether the plan is feasible, its feasibility score, charts and key figures on a single page.
  • Business Assumptions Input, enter selling prices, sales volume, growth, variable costs, fixed costs and financial parameters.
  • Initial Capital Breakdown, group your capital needs into fixed assets, working capital and start-up costs.
  • Automated 5-Year Projections, covering the income statement, asset depreciation and annual cash flow.
  • 5 Feasibility Indicators, including break-even point, payback period, NPV, IRR and first-year net profit, complete with a score and an automatic conclusion.
  • Scenario Testing, compare pessimistic, realistic and optimistic scenarios when sales, prices, costs or capital change.

Why this template

  • 2 Excel files (.xlsx): a blank template ready to fill in and a fully completed sample template.
  • Formulas, charts and conclusions are calculated automatically.
  • Shows how far sales can safely drop and the break-even point in units per day.
  • Includes a user guide and a plain-language explanation of each indicator.
  • Scenario assumptions can be adjusted to your own needs.

Who is it for?

Business owners about to open a new business or branch, management weighing up an expansion plan, and finance teams that need to present feasibility calculations before an investment decision is made.

Make business decisions based on clear calculations, not just estimates.
